question.prompt: A drawing has a scale of \(1:200\). A rectangular vacant lot measures 5 cm long and 3 cm wide on the drawing. What is its actual area in \(\text{m}^2\)?

solutions.explanation: The actual length is \(5\times200=1000\) cm \(=10\) m, and the actual width is \(3\times200=600\) cm \(=6\) m. The area is \(10\times6=60\text{ m}^2\).
solutions.title: Find the actual dimensions and multiply
